label: The True Nature of the Sword: B

lines.text: The Ark Buster's beam slices the air.
The transformed Egovista flies majestically in the air.
The Ark Buster aims its hand again.
Ark Ranger Blue keeps following Egovista's movements.
Once she's certain she's figured out the pattern, she fires a shot where she predicts Egovista will move next.
Egovista pauses as the Ark Buster's beam reaches her.
Egovista uses her sword to deflect the beam.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Did she just deflect a laser with her blade? I didn't realize we were fighting some crazy swordmaster...

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Hmm. Against an adversary small as this,

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: mayhap I must needs brandish my blade thus.
Egovista swings her sword at random.
Her strikes fill the air, leaving no room to get by.
Papillon gives up the charge and changes direction.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Unbelievable. It's like an artillery barrage, but with a sword...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hey! Get down here and fight! Quit flying around like a coward!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Did ye not say that to win is of most import?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: My thinking is as yours. Heh... I was a fool to set my heart so upon the sword. 'Twas vanity.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Far easier it be to fix one's eyes upon victory alone.
Everyone stares up nervously at the sky
when they see something flash high above them.
Sword in hand, Egovista plummets rapidly toward the ground.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: She's aiming for the Ark Buster!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: A clean division in a single strike... A sundering of steel.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Let me see if I cannot cleave so huge a mass in twain.
She falls in a fierce pose.
In only moments, she's nearly upon them.
An Ark Nova dyes the area in blue light as it bursts toward Egovista.
The Ark Nova splits in half and scatters.
Egovista plummets, making no attempt to slow her fall.
Like a meteor falling to Earth, she craters the ground and sends a cloud of dust flying.
Egovista's blow, which began at a dizzying height, strikes toward the Ark Buster.
The arc of the sword aims precisely for the Ark Buster's head.
The sound of metal rings out along with a shock wave.
The Ark Buster's feet are driven into the ground.
Egovista's sword is trapped between the Ark Buster's hands.
A series of ominous creaks come from all over the robot.
With her blade still trapped, she pushes forward.
Horrible noises echo from the Ark Buster's arms.
The Ark Buster's left arm breaks.
The enormous blade strikes deep in the Ark Buster's body.
From the left shoulder to the abdomen, the robot splits open with the sword still embedded in it.
The only thing left intact is the right arm.
The Ark Buster uses its right arm to strike the blade of the sword embedded in it.
As the arm bursts into pieces,
Egovista's greatsword also cracks and breaks.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Ah. To strike at an optical weapon was, no doubt, folly.
Papillon follows her movement in the air.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Oh? Dost thou think to pursue me because my sword is shortened?

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: I'm the type of coward who never lets a weakened enemy get away!
Egovista swings her sword at random.
Papillon charges forward, thinking that nothing has changed.
As the bombs get hit by the sword, they burst into particles, which show the arc of the sword.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Yeah, I can see! The sparkling is beautiful! It makes it easy to see!
The scattering bombs show the arc of the sword, but still...

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: ... It's basically just a glowing ball at this point.
She should avoid it. There's no way she can break through there.
On the day the sky turned red,
she remembers the story of her friend
who charged without hesitation into the sky raining red.
She remembers how she sat still and listened to that story.
What in the world were you thinking when you rushed forward?
Did you really think you'd get through to the other side, when the beams were pouring down like rain?
It was because, even if it cost you your life, you wanted to protect...
Agh, I can't even finish that line. It's so cliche and boring.
I was never interested in stories where people gave their lives because they have something to protect.
I figured there couldn't be anything in the world more important than my own self.
Papillon thinks about the Ark sitting on the surface.
It turns out there actually is something.
Which means that maybe, just like you,

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: I can go a little crazy too!
She throws her body into the wall of sword blows.
If she gets hit, she'll die. The thought of it frays her nerves.
She has no idea how she's moving.
She reads the flashing arcs, and by instinct, in a daze,
she avoids every blow and grows closer to Egovista.
Papillon thrusts her spear into the core.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I should think not. 'Tis a pity.
A metallic sound rings out for a brief moment.
It slashes through Papillon's wings and body.
She falls, bright red blood flowing.
With a cry of anguish, Anis runs.
She catches Papillon just before she hits the ground, and the two roll along the ground.
Anis scrambles upright and checks on Papillon.
Her wings and body are scored by the blade,
and blood flows from her wounds.
Egovista had swung her sword with all her might to stop the Nikke from approaching.
Yet she made her way through that rain of blows and stabbed her spear into Egovista's core.
Egovista looks down at her core.
It shakes faintly, the spear still lodged in it.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Hadst thou but a little more might, I should have been the one to fall.
Egovista moves her hand to pull the spear out of her core.
A chill runs down her spine. It's a new sensation to her.
A blue light flashes in the corner of Egovista's eye.
The moment she turns her head,
her core is pierced, and her body breaks in two.
The blue light strikes Egovista and continues on.
Her core breaks, revealing the human form of Egovista inside.
She suffers damage too great for her regeneration to keep up with.
She can't maintain altitude. A feeling of helplessness comes over her whole body.
She thinks that she must retreat.
The moment she turns her body...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?!
... she makes eye contact with Anis, who's swooping down from above.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: A robot threw me! Whatcha gonna do about it?
Anis strikes Egovista's face with a glowing fist.
The Ark Buster's left arm falls to the ground.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Throwing her was... quite the move.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Come on, Anis...! We're counting on you!

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: The attack seems to have hit. The marker reacted.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We don't know. The jamming is too strong.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: By narrowing the radius of Eden's Spear, we managed to condense it and drastically increase its speed and range.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: The signal was also strong enough to get past the Queen's high-powered jamming. I would say this was a success.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: And the fact that we could use Papillon's spear as a marker to deliver a precision strike...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... means Eden's Spear is no longer just a defensive weapon.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Then I guess we have no choice but to leave the rest to them.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: If you have time to complain, then hurry up and reestablish comms.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Right. That's the best we can do for now.
Anis hangs from Egovista's back unleashing blow after blow with her fist.
Every time her fist lands, a star-shaped explosion bursts out.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I told you not to call me that! It's rude!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... But never did I speak it ere now.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ha! Can't hit me with your sword if I'm right behind you, huh?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You're stuck! With me! Until you die!
Despite her drastic changes in direction, Anis doesn't fall off.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Would that I had a more preferable method than this...
With Anis still clinging to her back, Egovista abruptly drops.
It feels like Anis's core is dropping.
Yet she continues punching Egovista in the back.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Is thy power spent? What misfortune.
Anis squeezes with her arms and even her legs, pulling Egovista's body close.
Ark Ranger Black gazes at the screen beyond the Ark Buster's cockpit.
Egovista and Anis fall as one.
Ark Ranger Black grits her teeth.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: The Ark Buster won't be able to take it either!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Trust Anis! Trust the Ark Buster! Here goes!
Sparks burst from it along with clouds of smoke.
It looks up and watches the falling Anis and Egovista.
Light bursts from the Ark Buster's body.
Explosions burst from the Ark Buster,
but it keeps firing the Ark Nova.
Its final light covers Egovista and Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: One Nikke is a small price to pay for a Heretic!
The light completely swallows them up.
The light roars for a while before finally settling.
Egovista looks at her tattered body.
The regeneration is late. It's too late.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... It seems she burned away to naught.
She looks at the unmoving Ark Buster.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: If you feel despair closing in, raise your head to the sky!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: The star of the Ark is shining!
A star gleams above Egovista's head.
Anis charges forward as fast as a flash of light.
Her speed is transcendent. It's too fast for Egovista to react.
She keeps going until they reach the ground.
Egovista begins adjusting to Anis's speed.
She swings her sword, deflecting Anis's fists.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I understand now... At last, I understand!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: The true nature of the sword!
but all her attacks are blocked.
She suddenly feels like she's in a nightmare.
The sensations of her body are the same as before,
but her opponent is moving at the same speed.
She draws energy from her core,
and sends it all to her expansive armament.
Her body feels like it's going to burn up.
It made it to the surface.
Now it's time to make it shine.
As the star of the Ark, I'm going to make it shine,
even if it burns me up in the process.
I may get turned to ash, but my light will reach the Ark!
She can't see anything. Her vision is full of light.
Egovista exceeds her own limits once again.
The starlight and blade glint madly.
they prepare to land their final blows on each other.
Anis reaches out her fist, and Egovista swings her sword.
Oh... I can't dodge this one.
Anis grows sure of this as she sees Egovista's sword aim for her throat.
She gives up on defense and increases her speed.
As time slows down, Anis can feel the blade digging into her neck.
She pays it no mind, focusing only on swinging her fist.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Ahh... This. This was it all the while.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: The true nature... of the sword.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I thank thee. 'Twas by thy hand that I did arrive at this lofty peak.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Though mine was a worthless life, made in imitation by a cold, mere machine,

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I can at last define myself.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Ah... Methinks, as I am now,

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Scarlet and I could cross swords and have a wondrous discourse.
Nothing is left in the air.
She feels her neck. If the blade had gone any deeper, she would've been in trouble.
She feels relieved. Only then does the pain begin.
Her arms are in tatters. She can even see her frame.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Sorry, but... do you have any first aid supplies?
walking toward the Goddess of Victory Statue.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Take care of Papillon and protect the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We can fight better knowing our backs are covered.
The Ark Buster is in ruins. It can't move anymore.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: All right. Go do what you need to do.
She staggers toward the Goddess of Victory Statue.
